table.name: torrent_tags
table.purpose: Associative table linking torrents to descriptive tags (e.g. genre/style labels like 'electronic', '2010s', 'instrumental'). Each row is one tag applied to one torrent. The referenced table 'torrents' holds the torrent records; col_007 there is its primary key (torrent ID).

col_001.name: tag_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the tags table; unique sequential integer ID for each tag assignment row (0 to 161282). Referenced one-to-one by torrents.col_007, suggesting torrents.col_007 stores the latest/current tag ID for each torrent.

col_002.name: torrent_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to torrents.col_007 (many-to-one). Identifies which torrent the tag applies to; a torrent can have many tags.

col_003.name: tag
col_003.description: The tag label applied to the torrent: genre/style/era descriptors such as 'electronic', '2010s', 'instrumental', 'freely.available', 'experimental', plus artist/scene-specific tags like 'makiza', 'turkish'.

table.name: torrents
table.purpose: Music release torrents (albums, singles, EPs, mixtapes, etc.), each row one release/torrent with title, artist, year, release type, and internal IDs; tags table links tags to each torrent.

col_001.name: title
col_001.description: Release title (album/single/EP name), e.g. 'the predator', 'cheers'. HTML entities appear unescaped in some values.

col_002.name: artist_id
col_002.description: Numeric ID of the artist; low-cardinality integer (2816 distinct) matching the ~2800 distinct artist names in col_003, so likely a key into an artist table not present in this database.

col_003.name: artist
col_003.description: Artist name, e.g. 'ice cube', 'various artists', 'dj screw'.

col_005.name: release_type
col_005.description: Release category: album, single, ep, compilation, mixtape, live album, soundtrack, etc. (15 distinct values).

col_006.name: torrent_id
col_006.description: Unique ID of the torrent, likely from the source site (values up to ~73 million, e.g. What.cd-style torrent IDs).

col_007.name: id
col_007.description: Primary key of this table (0..75718, one per row); referenced by tags.col_002 to attach tags to a torrent, and one-to-one with tags.col_001.
